name: SensFRX Fraud Prevention
description: Integrate the SensFRX fraud-detection service to screen users and orders.
project_description:
AI-powered fraud prevention solution that stops bots, prevents fraudulent orders, chargebacks and carding attempts. Get actionable insights real-time to protect your store from frauds and spams.

 This module integrates Drupal commerce with Sensfrx https://sensfrx.ai fraud prevention services. Protect your store from fake registrations, bot attacks, account takeovers, credential stuffing, fraudulent orders, card testing attempts, promo/free trial abuse before they become chargebacks.

 Features 
 
 Device Intelligence 
 Advanced Behavioral Analysis 
 Cross-session fraud linking 
 Proxy/ VPN risk scoring 
 Multi-accounting Detection 
 Real time risk scoring on each activity 
 
 Required API Credentials 
 
To use this module, you must first create a SensFRX account at

 https://client.sensfrx.ai/signup .

 
After signing up, you will receive your Property ID and

 Property Secret Key , which are required to connect your Drupal

site with the SensFRX service. A free plan with 500 API credits per month is available.

 Post-Installation 
 
 Install the module via the Drupal Extend page or with Drush:

 drush en sensfrx -y 
 After installation, you will be redirected automatically to the SensFRX setup screen:

 Administration → SensFRX → Setup 
 
 Enter your email to connect your Drupal site with SensFRX. Use the same email you used when signing up on the SensFRX portal.

 Once verified, the connection is created and your dashboard becomes available.
 
 After successful authentication, you will be redirected to the SensFRX Dashboard:

 Administration → SensFRX → Dashboard 

 where you can view activity, risk scores, device intelligence, and recent events.
 
 Configure which activities you want to protect (registrations, logins, profile updates, Commerce orders, etc.). 
 Set up your fraud prevention policies (Allow, Block, Review) based on SensFRX risk scoring. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 
 Drupal 10 or 11. 
 PHP 8.1 or higher. 
 Drupal Commerce (optional) if you want to enable e-commerce fraud checks. 
 
 Recommended modules/libraries 
 
 Drupal Commerce – to monitor orders and transactions. 
 
 Similar projects 
 There are several modules that address specific aspects of spam and abuse, such as Honeypot, CAPTCHA, or login throttling. SensFRX is focused on broader fraud and risk management across multiple flows (authentication, registration, comments, and transactions) and uses configurable policies and a central dashboard to review and act on events.

 Supporting this Module 
 Bug reports, feature requests, and support questions can be filed in the project issue queue on Drupal.org.

 For commercial support or enterprise integrations, contact the SensFRX team via the documentation site or your existing SensFRX account.

 Community Documentation 
 
 SensFRX documentation: https://docs.sensfrx.ai 
 Drupal documentation: https://www.drupal.org/docs
